svg.title: White Curve in Relief over White (Belle Île)
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Complete gallery silo shows a pale triangular backing with a curving white raised panel. Two white shades distinguish panels while sharing recolor family. No exact dimensions: normalized only; external shadow omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-05-2015/lightbox/works/white-curve-in-relief-over-white-belle-île-2013-39467; record matthewmarks-white-curve-in-relief-over-white-belle-ile-2013-39467; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
